title:
This transform is used to determine whether the features of the sensor correlation jobs page should be displayed.
There are five variables in the input JSON:
- isComplete: whether the sensor correlation jobs are complete.
- isModelAdministrator: whether the user is a model administrator.
- nonModelAdministratorValue: if the user is not a model administrator, the returned value of the transform.
- completeValue: if the sensor correlation jobs are complete, the returned value of the transform.
- nonCompleteValue: if the sensor correlation jobs are not complete, the returned value of the transform.
name: SensorCorrelationJobsTransform
